Name: Event_BurningFields
EventDescription: Sole survivor of the Battle of Burning Fields. Watched the entire squad burn alive in a magical firestorm.
MentalScar: Smell of ash triggers panic attacks. Flinches at sudden bright lights.

Name: Event_PlagueSurvivor
EventDescription: Lost entire family to the Red Plague. Lived alone in a quarantined zone for 2 years while neighbors turned into monsters.
MentalScar: Obsessive cleanliness. Refuses to shake hands. Keeps distance.

Name: Event_BetrayedNoble
EventDescription: Was formerly high nobility but was framed by a trusted advisor and stripped of all titles. Spent 5 years in a debtor's prison.
MentalScar: Trusts no one. Constantly checks for exits. Hoards small valuable items.
